# Baywest Medical

> > Baywest Medical is a chiropractic clinic in New Port Richey, Florida, offering comprehensive pain relief and injury recovery services through advanced techniques including cold laser therapy, shock wave therapy, and specialized adjustments.

Led by Dr. Scott Coletti and a team of experienced chiropractors (Dr. Drasti Patel and Dr. Dan MacDougall), Baywest Medical serves the greater Tampa Bay area including New Port Richey, Largo, Trinity, and Holiday with evidence-based chiropractic care, physiotherapy, and innovative non-invasive therapies.
